home.heroSubtitle: We conduct foundational and applied research in high-altitude aerial perception, autonomous traffic anomaly detection, document analysis, and multimodal deep learning at the University of Information Technology.
home.heroImageCaption: UIT Together research group meeting and discussion session

about.facilityBuilding: Block A, University of Information Technology
about.facilityAddress: Quarter 6, Linh Trung Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
about.facilityDescription: Operating out of Room A108 in Block A, our laboratory is equipped with dedicated high-performance GPU workstations optimized for training deep neural architectures in aerial computer vision, multi-modal representation learning, and real-time streaming video anomaly detection.
about.leadershipDescription: Founded and directed by Dr. Nguyễn Tấn Trần Minh Khang and Dr. Võ Duy Nguyên, UIT-Together bridges academic research with impactful real-world applications in Vietnamese urban safety, autonomous transportation, and document intelligence.

footer.tagline: A pioneering research laboratory affiliated with the University of Information Technology (VNU-HCM), driving scientific innovation in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Aerial Remote Sensing, and Multimodal AI.
